summary_md: **Shawn Bang ([@wushi123321](https://x.com/wushi123321/status/2115899261128733031))** covers JetBrains' open-source **ThinkRail**, a light IDE around the pi coding agent with isolated git-worktree workspaces for parallel agents, Monaco editor, terminals, diff review and a graph of SPEC.md living specs; Apache-2.0 and early, with desktop builds for macOS, Windows and Linux ([JetBrains/thinkrail](https://github.com/JetBrains/thinkrail)).
